facts.business: Accord Transformer & Switchgear Limited designs, engineers, manufactures, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical infrastructure solutions including power and distribution transformers, dry-type and special-purpose transformers, compact substations, switchgear panels, control panels, busduct systems and EV charging solutions for utilities, renewable energy, industrial manufacturing, commercial infrastructure and other critical sectors.

key_risks: Geopolitical conflicts disrupting energy markets and global supply chains

facts.related_party_note: All Related Party transactions during FY 2025-26 were on arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business.
